title: Practice Inbox
description: Welcome to your Practice Inbox! This is a safe space. No real money or personal information is connected here. Read the emails below and practice spotting the patterns. Click 'This is a Scam' or 'This is Safe' for each one.

emails.subject: Receipt for your recent purchase - $499.99
emails.body:
Dear Customer,

Your credit card has been charged $499.99 for your annual computer support subscription. If you did not authorize this purchase, you must click the link below immediately to cancel the charge and get a refund.
emails.justInTimeHint: Take a close look at the sender's email address and the tone of the message. Does it feel rushed?

emails.subject: Please help, I'm in trouble!
emails.body: Hi, it's me. I lost my phone and I am stranded. Please don't tell mom and dad, they will be so mad at me. I need you to buy $200 in Apple gift cards and send me the codes so I can get a ride home. Please hurry!
emails.justInTimeHint: Take a close look at the sender's email address and the tone of the message. Does it feel rushed?

emails.subject: URGENT: Your account will be locked
emails.body: We noticed unusual activity on your account. For your safety, we will permanently lock your account in 12 hours unless you verify your identity. Click the link below to log in and confirm your password.
emails.justInTimeHint: Take a close look at the sender's email address and the tone of the message. Does it feel rushed?

emails.subject: Sunday dinner recipe
emails.body:
Hi! I was hoping you could send me that wonderful chicken recipe you made last week? No rush at all, just whenever you have a moment. Hope you are doing well!

Love, Martha.
emails.justInTimeHint: This message seems relaxed and comes from a familiar friend.

gentleFailure.title: A Great Learning Moment!
gentleFailure.message: You are in the perfect place to practice this! Notice how this message uses urgency and asks for money to make you rush. You are completely safe here in the simulator. For next time, remember you can always pause and call the company directly. Let's keep building those skills!

success.title: Wonderful Observation!
success.message: You took your time and noticed the warning signs. By looking out for urgency and requests for money, you are making very safe choices. Let's keep going!
